finding: pnpm 12.16.1 was newer than the seven-day npm release age policy.
resolution: The system fixture now pins eligible pnpm 10.34.8; the release age policy remains enabled.

finding: Fixture gh and sfw shebangs embedded a Bun executable path containing spaces and could not launch.
resolution: Fixture commands use /usr/bin/env bun; the tests also passed with Bun copied into a path containing spaces.

finding: A group-writable vendor Python executable was rejected despite an owner-only ancestor directory.
resolution: Accept group writes only behind an owner-only ancestor, watch that boundary and executable permissions, and retain refusal for publicly writable executables.

finding: Package verification using an encoded file URL as the import resolution parent could miss the destination runtime or load the operator runtime for Unicode and spaced paths.
resolution: Resolve from the destination filesystem directory with Bun.resolveSync in a fresh process, then import the resulting file URL. The regression imports a real temporary runtime and transitive dependency.

finding: The Ubuntu PHP installation reported 66 absolute resources, exceeding the original limit of 64.
resolution: Allow up to 256 resources while keeping the 128 KiB metadata bound and broad-directory refusals; assert all 66 fixture files remain selected.

finding: The new installed-tool contract omitted the baseline required by resolveShellPolicy.
resolution: Use validatePiSandboxConfig to obtain the actual closed baseline.

finding: The system PHP dependency closure produced redundant file and compatibility alias grants, and the Linux helper launch failed with E2BIG.
resolution: Compact exact selections by parent, remove grants already covered by declared runtime directories, and use canonical library directories when those directories are already searched. Required loader aliases remain exact selections.

finding: Composer failed because the PHP timezone database was inaccessible.
resolution: Discover the PHP include path and the existing system timezone directory with its other resources.

finding: System Go could not read fmt through the GOROOT/src symlink.
resolution: Include the known standard library resource explicitly and watch its link target.

finding: System Go could not read pkg/include/textflag.h for assembly.
resolution: Include the SDK assembly header resource explicitly; the fixture covers both split resources.

finding: Real mise shims reported tools inactive under the minimal probe environment. The installer had stored global configuration at XDG_CONFIG_HOME outside the disposable HOME.
resolution: Retain the four standard absolute XDG directory selectors while excluding unrelated variables. The fixtures verify both XDG propagation and omission of a secret canary variable.

finding: A mise-resolved command alias such as php pointing to php8.5 was lost after metadata inspection.
resolution: Authorize the resolved command launcher and its real target rather than the mise shim. Both ordinary and versioned launchers are fixture-tested; the final mise CI cases use real shims.

finding: The locked Ubuntu snapshot returned HTTP 503 and apt subsequently lacked pinned package versions.
resolution: Keep all native pins unchanged. Explicit runtime reuse verifies a successful original builder job, unchanged native source owners and dependency inputs, and the archive hash. The default fresh native build remains available.

finding: The reuse source had a failed native builder.
outcome: The native-reuse job failed before artifact download, and both platform installation jobs were skipped.

finding: A separate test branch changed the native input-lock file.
outcome: The unchanged-input comparison failed before artifact download, and both platform installation jobs were skipped. The test-only input change is absent from the implementation branch.
